# 2. SDK API Reference

Every `na8ve-os` Arduino sketch runs inside an isolated sandbox and interacts with neural inference, graph memory, sensor telemetry, and actuators through clean C++ library headers.

---

## `<Na8veOS.h>` (`Na8ve` & `Serial`)

- `void Na8ve.reply(const char *str)` / `void Na8ve.reply(const void *buf, size_t len)`
  Sends a response string or binary buffer back to the caller inside `onMessage(...)`.
- `int64_t Na8ve.nowUs()`
  Returns monotonic elapsed time in microseconds.
- `void Na8ve.yield()`
  Cooperatively yields execution time to sibling tasks.
- `void Na8ve.log(const char *msg)`
  Logs a short metadata message (capped at `120` bytes; never log raw audio, camera frames, transcripts, or credentials).
- `Serial.print(...)` / `Serial.println(...)`
  Metadata logging helper built over `Na8ve.log()` (emits to the system log stream without trailing newlines; use `Na8ve.reply(...)` for interactive console responses).

---

## `<Na8veModel.h>` (`Na8veModel`)

Submits non-blocking text prompts to the on-device recurrent byte-level neural engine. Responses arrive asynchronously in `onModelReply(const char *text, int32_t len, int32_t err)`.

- `int32_t Na8veModel.request(const char *prompt, uint8_t max_bytes = 32)`
- `int32_t Na8veModel.request(const char *prompt, size_t len, uint8_t max_bytes)`
  Queues an inference request (`1..64` generated bytes, prompt up to `256` bytes).
  - Synchronous return values:
    - `0` when queued.
    - `N8_MODEL_E_BUSY` (`-1`) if a turn is already in flight.
    - `N8_MODEL_E_SIZE` (`-3`) if `prompt` is null or exceeds `256` bytes.
    - Negative permission error if model IPC capability is not granted.
  - Asynchronous `err` values passed to `onModelReply(text, len, err)`:
    - `0` on success (`text` holds `len` generated bytes).
    - `N8_MODEL_E_RATE` (`-2`) if called faster than the per-app request interval (`500 ms`).
    - `N8_MODEL_E_MODEL` (`-4`) if no neural model is loaded.
    - `N8_MODEL_E_REPLY` (`-5`) if the broker reply could not be decoded.
- `bool Na8veModel.pending()`
  Returns `true` while an inference turn is in flight.

---

## `<Na8veStore.h>` (`Na8veStore`)

Queries the on-device three-tier memory graph (`sensory`, `episodic`, `semantic`) with bounded results. Requires read store permission.

- `int32_t Na8veStore.recall(const char *query, Na8veRecallResult *out, int32_t k = 4)`
  Searches live memories and fills `out`:
  - `out->count`: number of returned items (bounded up to `8`)
  - `out->truncated`: `true` if matching results exceeded the read bound
  - `out->hits[i].id` and `out->hits[i].score_milli` (`score * 10000`) per hit, plus `out->raw` formatted text summary
  - Returns the hit count (`>= 0`) on success or a negative error code.

---

## `<Na8veAct.h>` (`Na8veAct`)

Submits high-level actuator state proposals rather than writing raw GPIO registers. Every proposal is validated by the board's actuator safety policy before any hardware pin changes. Requires actuation permission.

- `int32_t Na8veAct.propose(const char *actuator, const char *state, char *verdict_out = nullptr, size_t cap = 0)`
  Proposes a named actuator transition (for example `"fan"`, `"low"`, `"mister"`, `"light"`, `"buzzer"`, `"pump"`, `"vent"`).
  - Optionally writes the policy verdict JSON text into `verdict_out`.
  - Returns `0` if approved/acted, or `-1` if rejected by pin-reservation, range, or cooldown rules.

---

## `<Na8veSeam.h>` (`Na8veSeam`)

Reads metadata-only sensor observations registered with the observation seam. Requires seam permission.

- `int32_t Na8veSeam.read(const char *subject, char *json_out, size_t cap)`
  Fetches the latest bounded observation JSON for a supported subject (`"device"` for on-chip temperature, or `"greenhouse"`, `"tank"`, `"door"`) into `json_out`. Returns bytes written (`>= 0`) or a negative error code.
